_artifact: ORCH-1: canonical engineering-capability taxonomy. Routing decisions (router/select-adapter.js) are made from these capability IDs, never from adapter/product names.
_enforcement_note: Inventory only. Nothing gates execution on this file yet; router/select-adapter.js (ORCH-2) is the first consumer, and it is itself a stub.

capabilities.description: Decomposing a task into an ordered implementation approach before writing code.
Reasoning about system structure, module boundaries, and design tradeoffs.
Writing or editing source files to realize a plan.
Root-causing a defect from a failure signal (error, test failure, unexpected behavior).
Writing or executing automated tests / eval suites against real code.
Exercising a change end-to-end to confirm it does what it claims, beyond trusting test output alone.
Critiquing a diff or plan for correctness, maintainability, or scope issues.
Identifying exploitable vulnerabilities, unsafe input handling, or supply-chain risk.
Executing shell commands and reading their output.
Driving or reading a web browser session.
Reading or writing git history/state (diff, commit, branch) safely.
Diagnosing or driving a build/test/gate pipeline, including non-interactive failure diagnosis.
Producing or maintaining human-readable docs, reports, or structured documents.
Maintaining useful reasoning quality over a large amount of accumulated context.
Reading non-text inputs (images, screenshots) as part of the task.
Running multiple independent sub-tasks concurrently and aggregating results.
Running a task in a sandboxed/fresh environment with no leakage into or from the caller's live state.
Producing machine-parseable output (JSON/schema-conformant) on request, not just prose.
Continuing or resuming a prior session/conversation without losing state.
Reporting token usage, wall-clock time, or dollar cost for a given invocation.
